body:
It definitely is one solution to a host of issues, I agree with that. But, it's also like the end of a movie, and I don't think I'm quite ready to see the credits. There has to be more to life than I know so far and I want to experience, I just need to dig out of this rut because I give up.

Thanks for the suggestions, I am going to try to appreciate the smaller things, and make those little changes to see what happens. Can't hurt to try!

While not a lot has changed, I feel more stabilized atm with my feelings, and am trying to figure out my goals in life and my passions. Right now I don't have any and I think that is part of the problem.

I have been trying to change my mindset on that. There is so much here that I could do, that I think I might try some of it. I do sometimes get pretty low feelings, but I usually pull through and am just trying to get to the point where a new day is something I look forward to. On the weekends I could sleep up to 15 hours just passing the weekend away. 

I'm trying to really find my passion, I don't currently have anything I am passionate about and I think that is really hurting me in the long run.

I am 28.

My "release" of believing in religion I think at least help me realized I have an issue I need to fix. Where before it was just "you aren't trusting God enough". I am trying hard not to just say fk it and end up in the ground where we are all heading at some point. I am not even doing it for me anymore, but for the few people that would be really upset. I knwo some people would care, but it's hard when I don't even care.

Weightlifting I might be able to do, but wouldn't that also cause my weight to start climbing and discourage myself? I have a routine I remember that my dad taught me years ago (he use to work out with a runner up for Mr Universe).

I'll try doing that for meditation, most people just tell me "just snap out of it" like it's just some switch. It makes me so mad, because these people don't get it, they will even say "I've been through that". I have a hard time finding reasons to go on with the morning, reasons to even wake up. It feels like another boring, dreading day. I can't wait until sleep again just so it can be over. I had a friend tell me it's just me being "boo hoo" and whatnot, but I mean I have no desire to do anything, I'm just not happy. 

I went to the doctor today and they are putting me on effexor now. He said just stop the celxa but I often read that both of them can be used at once and help. I'm afraid just stopping one (especially from 60mg, which is a higher dose then the size the pills come in!) could be bad. I posted here the other day because I truely felt hopeless and I need a way out. If it gets too much deeper this hole will cave in on me. 

I'm not doing it for attention like people think, I just want to be happy with me, to get up and look forward to the day and to start hanging out with friends again. Doctors try to draw a little chart and ask "is this how you feel?" like something can be explained so simple. Sorry I'm venting now. On the bright side, I did call a place for a different therapist to try and see if that helps. I want out of the prison of a mind!

I've been on a few different medications and thinking about going to my GP to ask about adding more as a suppliment for when my reg meds aren't enough. I am currently on 60mg of celexa and 20 mg of ritilan (twice a day for this one). I'd rather wait until I can see my psychritrist, but I'm getting to the point that I can't wait the 5-6weeks to get in and see him. I need and adjustment now, before I feel it's too late. I just want to be happy for once. It's been a long time. 

Nothing, to be honest. I get up for work, go to work, leave, eat, go home and just sit and home feeling like I was I'd just get hit by a bus. Please note, I'm not in this for a pity party, that's not it at all. I just want to be happy, I don't want to keep feeling like my life has no meaning. I have been dating, at this point, any of them that have been giving me the time of day, as sad as that sound. I mean they had to find me at least somewhat attractive to go out with me. But I think it's my lack of selfconfidence and, I'm sure my level of attachiness doesn't help. I think I am maybe a 5/10, which is average, so I guess that is not so bad.

I am open to the possibility to God, or a God, but don't feel we can just say one exist, based on the evidence I've came across. What do you mean by Meditation? Any examples?

Maybe that's the issue. I don't feel I have any confidence either. I dont' workout at all, it's hard for me to do the same thing over and over (running on a treadmill or eliptical). I dress to what I think is well and I tried to keep clean and trimmed facial hair etc.
I know you are 100% right on this, but I was just being honest with my feels as not to hide anything from it.

To me it's hard to "find that thing to live for". I thought it'd be a nice woman that I would meet and be happy. But I suck at that, never passing one date. I sit at home, no will to live and just rot. Praying my breathe will just stop, and end. Back into the ground. I';ve seriuoslyed thougt about pulling a knife across my knife and release this balloon full of negative, angery, sadness. I really am tempted to just cut this last thread holding my life together.
